findings.description: Reusing the wrapper's statistics dictionary removes statistics isolation between overlapping invocations. The async wrapper introduces the same defect.
findings.rationale: When two concurrent calls to the same decorated function both fail their first attempt and retry, their retry-controller copies now update the same dictionary. Both increment its attempt_number, producing 3 although each call is only on attempt 2; callbacks reading retry_state.retry_object.statistics therefore receive incorrect statistics. Previously each copy had its own statistics dictionary. Concurrent clearing can also remove counters while another call is updating them.
